```python
def classify_tier(diff_text: str) -> dict:
    """Classify a PR diff and return tier selection + overlay flags.
    
    Returns dict matching review-complexity-classifier.sh JSON output:
    {
      "selected_tier": "light" | "standard" | "deep",
      "size_action": "none" | "warn" | "upgrade",
      "security_overlay": bool,
      "performance_overlay": bool,
      "test_quality_overlay": bool,
      "diff_size_lines": int,
      ...
    }
    """
```

Mirrors the logic in review-complexity-classifier.sh (bash → Python port).
Key signals: blast_radius, critical_path, anti_shortcut, staleness, cross_cutting, diff_lines, change_volume.
Tier thresholds: 0-2 → light, 3-6 → standard, 7+ → deep.
Size thresholds: >300 lines → upgrade, >600 lines → warn.

Read review-complexity-classifier.sh for the exact scoring logic to mirror.
